name: Tacos
intro: Roasted sweet potato, black beans, pomegranate, cotija. Sweet, sharp, and salty in one bite.
keep: Black beans, or protein of choice
season_options: Salted yogurt, in place of crema

variations.ingredients: Sweet potato + black beans + pomegranate + cotija
variations.context: The October taco. The pomegranate is the salsa.
Smear the jar on the warm tortilla first.
If you bought fish. Flaked, pan-seared, three minutes a side.

finish: Warm the tortillas over a flame or in a dry pan until they blister in spots, and stack them under a towel. Pomegranate goes on last so it stays cold against the warm sweet potato.
